stories.name: Intel Terafab chip venture
stories.blurb: Intel is pursuing partnerships with SK Hynix and others for Elon Musk's Terafab chipmaking venture and its Ohio fab, while facing potential competition from TSMC.

stories.name: Middle East market volatility
stories.blurb: Ongoing market swings driven by Middle East tensions, oil price moves, and uncertainty over the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.name: AMD stock surge
stories.blurb: AMD's stock has soared to a $1 trillion valuation, prompting debate over whether its AI-driven rally is justified or overpriced.

stories.name: Intel Turnaround Rally
stories.blurb: Intel's stock and analyst sentiment have been rallying on optimism that its turnaround strategy and AI-driven demand are gaining traction ahead of and following Q2 earnings.

stories.name: AI Chip Market Growth
stories.blurb: A collection of market reports highlighting how AI, 5G, and edge computing are driving rapid growth across semiconductors, chipsets, and related hardware markets where Intel competes.

stories.name: AI chip stock rally
stories.blurb: Investors are debating whether the surging valuations of AI chipmakers like NVIDIA and Marvell are justified by future growth or due for a pullback.

stories.name: ASML AI chip demand
stories.blurb: ASML is ramping up EUV lithography production and attracting investor attention as surging AI chip demand drives competition among major semiconductor players.

past.name: Intel-SK Hynix Ohio Deal
past.blurb: Intel is reportedly in talks with SK Hynix to manufacture memory chips at Intel's underused Ohio fab, boosting Intel's stock alongside a separate $15 billion capital raise for AI chip growth.

past.name: AI chip selloff
past.blurb: A broad selloff in AI-related chip and memory stocks, driven by bubble fears and weak guidance, is dragging down markets worldwide.

past.name: Meta Muse AI Chip Rally
past.blurb: Meta's new Muse AI agent sparked expectations of increased CPU demand, sending Intel, AMD, and Arm shares sharply higher amid broader moves in the AI chip sector.

past.name: Apple Ditching Qualcomm
past.blurb: Apple is gradually replacing Qualcomm's modem chips with its own in-house designs, raising questions about Qualcomm's future revenue and stock performance.

15.text: Tesla and SpaceX will independently build and operate the $16.8 billion Terafab chip complex in Texas, with Musk ruling out TSMC running it and Intel reportedly involved in design and manufacturing. Intel also unveiled new AI GPU chips to challenge Nvidia, while its stock fell about 6% on Terafab uncertainty.

5.text: Rising oil prices, higher Treasury yields, and an AI pullback drove sharp US stock selloffs, with semiconductors hit hard. Intel was mentioned only among stocks reflecting that broader market weakness, not for company-specific news.

11.text: AMD shares have surged over 200% in 2026, passing $1 trillion in market value on gigawatt-scale AI chip commitments, though its key product hasn't shipped at scale and analysts debate valuation. Micron and Applied Materials articles compare those chip stocks to AMD, with one noting a valuation gap versus Intel.

7.text: Intel shares have surged over 200% this year on strong Q2 results, foundry progress, and government and Nvidia investments, though analysts rate the stock a hold. Recent trading has been volatile, with shares falling 3.15% to $101.40 after earlier gains.

13.text: Two market research reports project strong growth in computer vision (to $76.8B by 2032) and visual computing (to $78.4B by 2030), listing Intel among the companies benchmarked in each. Intel is mentioned only as a profiled competitor, not as the subject of any specific development.

12.text: ASML is expected to report Q3 revenue of €11.7 billion with EPS nearly doubled, driven by AI chip demand. TSMC faces rising capex ($64 billion for 2026) and free-cash-flow pressure despite AI tailwinds. Intel is not mentioned.

4.text: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan confirmed Intel will keep working with Elon Musk on the Terafab chip venture, easing investor concerns after Musk signaled TSMC may sublease part of the fab rather than own it. Intel shares had fallen about 6% on the TSMC news before rebounding.

6.text: TSMC reported strong sales, but chip stocks including AMD fell after a report that OpenAI's annual revenue is near $50 billion, far below estimates. The Nasdaq dropped sharply, hitting debt-heavy AI names hardest; Intel is barely mentioned.

8.text: Meta's Muse AI chip news gave AMD and Intel investors reason to cheer, signaling a shift in the AI trade. The article only briefly touches Intel, treating it as a secondary beneficiary of Meta's move.
